title: Places, People & Clear Sentences
subtitle: Kişilik sıfatlarını tekrar et, yerleri tarif et ve in / on / at seçimini bağlamla öğren.

days.title: İnsanları to be ile tarif et
days.intro: Bu tekrar, derste konuştuğunuz personality adjectives konusunu korur. Amaç sıfatı doğru to be biçimiyle kullanmak ve kişiye özel cümleler kurmaktır.
days.remember: Bir kişiyi sıfatla tarif ederken am / is / are gerekir: She is creative. They are polite.
days.watchOut: Sıfatın önüne gereksiz a/an getirme: He is hardworking, He is a hardworking person.

rules.title: Doğru to be biçimi
rules.text: I ile am, he/she/it ile is, you/we/they ile are kullan.

rules.title: Sıfat ve isim
rules.text: Sıfat tek başına veya bir isimden önce gelebilir. İsim kullanırsan tekil sayılabilir isimde a/an gerekir.

rules.title: Olumsuz ve soru
rules.text: Olumsuzda not ekle; soruda am/is/are başa gelir.

words.definition: working with a lot of effort
words.example: My colleague is hardworking and finishes every task.

words.definition: able to produce new and interesting ideas
words.example: She is creative and has interesting ideas.
The receptionist is always polite.
He is shy when he meets new people.
I am annoyed because the bus is late.

practice.feedback: My colleague tekil olduğu için is gerekir.
practice.hint: Öznenin tekil mi çoğul mu olduğuna bak.

practice.feedback: Sıfat tek başına kullanıldığında a/an gelmez.
Manager tekil; to be sorusunda Is başa gelir.
practice.hint: Cümlede başka fiil yok, polite bir sıfat.

practice.prompt: They ___ shy; they speak to everyone.
practice.feedback: They ile are not / aren't kullanılır.
practice.hint: They için doğru to be olumsuzunu seç.

reading.title: Two colleagues
paragraphs: Ece and Murat work in the same office. Ece is creative and friendly. She always has interesting ideas, and she is polite when she explains them.
Murat is hardworking and careful. He is sometimes shy in large meetings, but he is not lazy. Ece and Murat are very different, but they are a good team.

questions.feedback: The first paragraph describes Ece as creative and friendly.

questions.prompt: Murat is always confident in large meetings.
questions.feedback: The text says he is sometimes shy.

questions.prompt: Why are they a good team?
options: Their different strengths work well together.
questions.feedback: The final sentence connects their differences with being a good team.
questions.hint: Use the contrast in the last sentence.

listening.title: Listen for personality adjectives
listening.instructions: Önce bir kez altyazısız dinle. İkinci dinlemede kişileri tarif eden sıfatları not al.
listening.task: En az üç sıfat yaz ve her biriyle kendi hayatından bir cümle kur.
listening.followUp: Which person sounds most like someone you know? Write two sentences.

test.feedback: I am is the correct form.
Friends is plural, so use are.
test.hint: Check whether the subject is plural.

test.prompt: He ___ rude; he always says please.
test.feedback: The second clause shows the negative is needed.
Use Is with she.
test.hint: Move to be before the subject.

test.feedback: They requires are; polite is used without a.

test.prompt: A person who works with a lot of effort is ___.
test.feedback: Hardworking means çalışkan.
test.hint: Think of someone who puts effort into work.

test.prompt: A person with new and interesting ideas is ___.
test.feedback: Creative is the correct adjective.
test.hint: Which word is connected to ideas?

test.prompt: Which sentence includes a noun after the adjective?
test.feedback: Designer is the noun, so a creative designer is correct.
We requires are.
test.hint: Use the plural form of to be.

test.prompt: ___ you shy when you meet new people?
test.feedback: Use Are with you in a to be question.
test.hint: There is no action verb here.

test.prompt: Which is NOT a personality adjective?
test.feedback: Office is a place/noun.
test.hint: Which word cannot describe a person?

test.prompt: The receptionist helps everyone and speaks kindly. She is ___.
test.feedback: Her behaviour is polite.
Isn't makes the sentence negative.

test.prompt: Which short answer is correct: Is Murat hardworking?
test.feedback: Repeat the correct to be form in the short answer.
Team is a singular countable noun: a good team.
test.hint: An adjective comes before a singular noun.

days.title: Bir yerde ne olduğunu anlat
days.intro: There is / there are konusu korunuyor çünkü yeni yer edatları için temel oluşturuyor. Bugün ofis, üniversite ve çevrendeki yerleri anlat.
days.remember: Tekil veya sayılamayan isimde there is; çoğul isimde there are kullan.
days.watchOut: There is nerede olduğunu değil, bir şeyin var olduğunu söyler. Konum için sonra in/on/at gibi bir ifade ekleyebilirsin.

rules.title: Tekil ve sayılamayan
rules.text: Bir şey veya sayılamayan bir madde varsa there is kullan.
examples: There is an office on the second floor.
There is water in the bottle.

rules.title: Çoğul
rules.text: Birden fazla şey için there are kullan.
examples: There are two stations near my office.
There are books on the desk.

rules.title: Soru ve olumsuz
rules.text: Soruda is/are başa gelir. Olumsuzda isn't/aren't kullan.

words.definition: a room or building where people work
words.example: There is a quiet office on this floor.
There is a university near the station.

words.definition: a place where trains or buses stop
words.example: There are two stations in the city.

words.definition: the area beside a train where passengers wait
words.example: There are many people on the platform.

words.definition: the area around where someone lives
words.example: There is a park in my neighbourhood.

practice.prompt: ___ a police station near my office.
practice.hint: Count the noun after the gap.
A number greater than one needs the plural form.

practice.feedback: Universities is plural and this is a question.
practice.hint: Put the plural to be form first.

practice.prompt: There ___ any water in the bottle.
practice.feedback: Water is uncountable, so use isn't.

reading.title: Around my office
paragraphs: My office is in a busy neighbourhood. There is a small café next to the building, and there is a bus stop in front of it. There are two banks on the same street.
There isn't a train station nearby, but there are frequent buses. Inside the office, there is a kitchen and there are three meeting rooms.

questions.prompt: What is next to the office building?
questions.feedback: The café is next to the building.
questions.hint: Read the first sentence about nearby places.

questions.prompt: There is a train station nearby.
questions.feedback: The text says there isn't a train station nearby.

questions.prompt: How many meeting rooms are there?

listening.title: Listen for there is / there are
listening.instructions: Dört kısa konuşmayı önce metne bakmadan dinle. İkinci dinlemede there is, there are, is there ve are there örneklerini not al.
listening.task: Her konuşmada insanların hangi yer veya şeylerin varlığından söz ettiğini yaz. Tekil ve çoğul isimleri iki gruba ayır.
listening.followUp: Write four sentences about your neighbourhood: one with there is, one with there are, one question and one negative sentence.

test.feedback: A park is singular.
Two banks is plural.
A kitchen is singular and the sentence is a question.
Buses is plural.

test.prompt: There ___ some water on the table.
test.feedback: Water is uncountable and takes is.
test.hint: Do not count water as individual items.

test.feedback: Use there is with a singular noun.

test.prompt: Which question asks about several stations?
test.feedback: Are there begins a plural question.

test.prompt: There is ___ café next to the building.
test.feedback: Café is a singular countable noun.
test.hint: Use an article for one café.

test.prompt: There are many people ___ the platform.
test.feedback: People wait on the platform surface/area.
test.hint: Think of the platform as an area or surface.

test.feedback: Neighbourhood is the surrounding local area.
Water is uncountable.
test.hint: Which one is not normally counted as one, two, three?

test.feedback: Three rooms requires are.

test.prompt: Short answer: Is there a café?
test.feedback: Repeat there is in the singular short answer.

test.prompt: Short answer: Are there any banks?
test.feedback: Use there aren't for a plural negative answer.
Station is singular, so use a.
test.hint: One singular countable place needs an article.

days.title: Yeri bağlama göre seç
days.intro: Derste in, on, at, under, next to, on the right ve on the left üzerinde durdunuz. Kelime kelime çeviri yerine, yerin alan mı, yüzey mi yoksa nokta mı olduğuna bak.
days.remember: in = bir alanın içinde; on = yüzey, hat veya toplu taşıma; at = belirli nokta veya etkinlik.
days.watchOut: Türkçedeki -de/-da her zaman tek bir İngilizce kelimeye dönüşmez. Doğru seçim bağlama bağlıdır.

rules.title: IN: içinde / alan
rules.text: Sınırları olan bir alan, şehir, ülke veya oda için sıkça in kullan.
examples: The keys are in the bag.

rules.title: ON: yüzey / hat / ulaşım
rules.text: Bir yüzeyde, katta, sokakta veya otobüs-tren gibi toplu taşıma araçlarında on kullan.
examples: The picture is on the wall.
My office is on King Street.

rules.title: AT: nokta / kurum / etkinlik
rules.text: Belirli bir nokta, adres, iş yeri veya etkinliğe odaklanırken at kullan.
examples: The office is at 10 King Street.

rules.title: Diğer konumlar
rules.text: Under, next to, on the right ve on the left iki şeyin birbirine göre konumunu açıklar.
examples: The bag is under the desk.
The café is next to the university.

words.definition: to use time doing an activity
words.example: I spend time reading on the train.
It is easy to make friends at university.

words.definition: to find something hard to do
words.example: I have difficulty choosing the right preposition.
I sit at my desk all day long.
There is a station nearby.

practice.prompt: I work ___ an office, but today I am ___ home.
practice.feedback: The room/building is an area: in an office. Home is the fixed expression at home.
practice.hint: One is an enclosed workspace; the other is a fixed home expression.

practice.feedback: Use at for a precise address.
practice.hint: A house number makes the location very specific.

practice.prompt: There is a picture ___ the wall.
practice.feedback: The picture touches/is displayed on a surface.

practice.prompt: The bag is ___ the desk, not on it.
practice.hint: The final phrase says not on top.

reading.title: From home to work
paragraphs: I live in Hamburg and work in an office on Hafen Street. Every morning, I wait at the bus stop. I read on the bus and get off next to the university.

My office is at 18 Hafen Street, on the third floor. My desk is on the right. There is a small cabinet under the window and a printer next to the door. I spend time at my desk all day long, but I have lunch in the kitchen.

questions.feedback: The text uses at for the stop as a point.

questions.prompt: The office is on the third floor.
questions.feedback: This appears in the second paragraph.

questions.prompt: What is next to the door?
questions.feedback: The printer is next to the door.

listening.title: Listen for directions
listening.instructions: İlk dinlemede hedef yeri bul. İkinci dinlemede konum ve yön ifadelerini yaz.
listening.task: in, on, at, next to, right veya left içeren ifadeleri yakala.
listening.followUp: Give directions from your workplace entrance to your desk using three location phrases.

test.feedback: Use in with countries.
The station is treated as a meeting point.
test.hint: Focus on the point where you meet.

test.feedback: Use on with a street name without a number.
test.hint: A street is treated as a line.

test.feedback: A precise address takes at.
test.hint: The house number creates a precise point.

test.feedback: The bag contains the keys.
The wall is a surface.
Use on for public transport such as a bus.
At work is the fixed expression for the activity/location.
test.hint: This is a common fixed expression.

test.feedback: Next to means beside.
Under means below the bed.

test.prompt: When I enter, the reception is ___.
test.feedback: On the right describes relative position.
Spend time means zaman geçirmek.
test.hint: The object is time, not money.

test.feedback: Have difficulty + -ing describes something hard to do.
Make friends is the natural phrase.
At home is the fixed expression.
test.hint: Home uses a special common pattern.

days.title: Üç konuyu tek bağlamda birleştir
days.intro: Son gün yeni kural eklemez. Personality adjectives, there is/are ve place prepositions konularını aynı cümlelerde kullanarak kalıcı hale getirir.
days.remember: Önce cümlenin işini belirle: kişiyi mi tarif ediyorsun, bir şeyin varlığını mı söylüyorsun, yoksa yerini mi belirtiyorsun?
days.watchOut: Türkçeden kelime kelime çevirmek yerine mesajı kur: özne + doğru yapı + net yer ifadesi.

rules.title: 3. Yerini netleştir
examples: The new colleague is at reception.
The offices are on the second floor.

words.example: Be careful on the platform.
My colleague is in the meeting room.
There is a sign at the entrance.
The kitchen is on the left.
There are buses all day long.

practice.prompt: There ___ a friendly receptionist ___ the entrance.
practice.feedback: One receptionist requires is; the entrance is a point, so at.
practice.hint: Check number first, then type of location.

practice.prompt: My colleagues ___ hardworking and they work ___ an office.
practice.feedback: Colleagues is plural; an office is an enclosed work area.

practice.prompt: There ___ two meeting rooms ___ the second floor.
practice.feedback: Two rooms requires are; floors take on.
practice.hint: Count the rooms and think of the floor level.

practice.prompt: Choose the clearest translation of 'Bütün gün ofisteyim.'
options: I am in office all day long.
I am at the office all day long.
There is me office all day.
I on office every day long.
practice.feedback: At the office identifies the workplace/location; all day long is the natural phrase.
practice.hint: Translate the meaning, not each Turkish ending.

reading.title: A new day at the office
paragraphs: There is a new colleague in our office. His name is Can. He is polite, hardworking and a little shy. His desk is on the left, next to the printer.
There are three meeting rooms on our floor. The largest room is at the end of the corridor. Can has difficulty finding it, so I show him around. We spend time together at lunch and make friends.

options: Polite, hardworking and a little shy
questions.feedback: The first paragraph gives all three adjectives.
questions.hint: Find the sentence after his name.

options: On the left, next to the printer
questions.feedback: The first paragraph gives the exact position.
questions.hint: Look for two place phrases together.

questions.prompt: Why does the writer show Can around?
options: Can has difficulty finding the meeting room.
questions.feedback: The text directly connects his difficulty with the help.
questions.hint: Read the second paragraph's final two sentences.

listening.title: Listen for be forms and introductions
listening.instructions: Dinlerken am/is/are biçimlerini ve kişilerin kendilerini nasıl tanıttığını not et.
listening.task: Üç doğru to be cümlesi yaz; birine bir yer ifadesi ekle.
listening.followUp: Introduce yourself, describe one colleague and say what there is near your workplace.

test.prompt: There ___ a polite receptionist ___ the entrance.
test.feedback: Singular receptionist takes is; entrance is a point.

test.prompt: My office is ___ the third floor.
test.feedback: Use on with floor levels.
test.hint: Think of a level in a building.

test.feedback: Manager is singular.
test.hint: Choose the singular to be form.

test.prompt: There ___ two shy students in the room.
test.feedback: Two students is plural.

test.prompt: We are ___ the bus, but our bags are ___ the car.
test.feedback: Use on for public transport, in for a car/container.
test.hint: The two types of transport follow different common patterns.

test.feedback: A café is singular, so ask Is there...?
test.hint: Start with the singular to be form.

options: The desk is on the left.
test.feedback: Careful describes the colleague.
test.hint: Find an adjective describing a person.

test.feedback: There is introduces the existence of a printer.
Next to is a place phrase.
test.hint: Only one option describes relative position.

test.feedback: The fixed phrase is have difficulty + -ing.

test.prompt: We ___ time practising English at lunch.
test.feedback: Spend time + -ing is the natural pattern.

test.prompt: Sefa and his colleagues ___ friends at work.
test.feedback: Make friends is the correct phrase.
Any works in a plural negative sentence.
test.hint: The noun is plural and the sentence is negative.

test.feedback: Use am + adjective without an article.
test.hint: There is no noun after the adjective.

test.prompt: Translate the idea, not word by word: 'Ofiste bir mutfak var.'
options: There is a kitchen in the office.
test.feedback: There is expresses existence; in the office gives location.
